pages.title: Attached and detached populations
pages.text:
Attached and detached populations
A + D = 1, with A, D ∈ [0, 1].
A ﬁxed population of heads changes category; ﬁlaments slide relative to one another.
Occupancy retains chemical state but discards displacement.

A three-stage calculation

pages.title: Euler accuracy and admissibility
pages.text:
Euler accuracy and admissibility
An+1 = An + h{f (1 − An) − gAn}.
An = 0.5, f = 3, g = 1, h = 0.05 gives 0.55; exact: 0.54532.
hf ≤ 1 and hg ≤ 1 preserve [0, 1]; smaller steps may still be needed for accuracy.
Mathematical Modeling Notes 13 / 19
